RSS (2 URLs) -> POST /v1/web/fetch provider=firecrawl -> keyword sentiment -> POST /api/news/sentiment.
Archive: OpenRouter embeddings openai/text-embedding-3-small (1536-d) -> POST /api/news/archive.
Chat/LLM not used here. Search/fetch stay on OmniRoute. No Telegram. No order execution.

### QT enrichment
